meta.title: L/100km to mpg — Convert Liter/100 km to Miles/Gallon (US) |
meta.description: Convert Liter/100 km (L/100km) to Miles/Gallon (US) (mpg) instantly. 1 L/100km = 235.21458 mpg. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert liter/100 kms (L/100km) to miles/gallon (us)s (mpg) instantly. Both measure fuel consumption, so the relationship is strictly linear: each liter/100 km equals 235.21458 miles/gallon (us)s. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One liter/100 km is equal to **235.21458 miles/gallon (us)s**. To go the other way, one miles/gallon (us) equals **235.21458 liter/100 kms**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> miles/gallon (us)s = liter/100 kms × 235.21458

Worked example — converting 10 liter/100 kms:

10 × 235.21458 = **23.521458 mpg**.

To invert, divide by 235.21458 (or multiply by 235.21458).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 L/100km ≈ 235.21458 mpg. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Liter/100 km and Miles/Gallon (US) both measure fuel consumption; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.

**Q:** How many miles/gallon (us)s are in 1 liter/100 km?
**A:** 235.21458 miles/gallon (us)s.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert L/100km to mpg?
**A:** miles/gallon (us)s = liter/100 kms × 235.21458.

**Q:** How do I convert mpg back to L/100km?
**A:** Multiply by 235.21458 (or divide by 235.21458).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.
